market_outlook.short_term: High volatility expected. Oil at $99-100 creates inflationary pressure that conflicts with bond market stress. S&P 500 short interest at decade highs means any positive catalyst triggers sharp squeezes. U.S. CPI print is the key near-term data event. Expect 5-8% two-way moves in equities over next 2-3 weeks. Crypto remains risk-off. LatAm EM is relative outperformer.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Nvidia, ASML, Arm) remains structurally intact despite data center delays. Copper/silver supercycle supports commodity equities through 2027. Social Security fiscal risk is a slow-burn issue. Trade wars add 100-150bp to risk premium. Defense spending elevated for 3+ years. Retail/real estate consolidation continues. Japan repatriation could reshape global bond flows over 6-12 months.
